{{Quote|Princess Leia, I've just had the most fascinating discussion about the complex dining etiquette on the planet Sisk, where all the spider people have eight arms&hellip;|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Dark Empire (audio)">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Sisk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that orbited a red dwarf [[Sisk|star]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]]. It cooled when its star suffered partial atomic collapse.

While Sisk had considerable natural resources, the antisocial nature of the Sic-Six made it impossible to exploit the planetary resources in any organized way.
